title: 听力挑战 · 写作批改讨论

rounds.speaker: 写作老师
rounds.line: Your opening sentence is weak, so I suggest using an inverted structure to attract the reader's attention.
rounds.lineCn: 你的开头句太弱,我建议用倒装结构来吸引读者注意。

grammar.name: 倒装句增色
grammar.note: suggest doing 后接建议内容;倒装结构(Never/Only 等提前)可使开头句更有力度。

options.text: The teacher suggests improving the opening with inversion.
options.feedback: 老师建议用倒装结构强化开头句。

options.text: The teacher suggests deleting the opening sentence.
options.feedback: 老师是建议改写强化,不是删除。

options.text: The teacher thinks the opening sentence is already strong.
options.feedback: 老师认为开头句偏弱,与原文相反。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: I always rely on simple sentences, but my teacher reminds me that complex structures impress examiners.
rounds.lineCn: 我总是依赖简单句,但老师提醒我,复杂的句式结构才能打动考官。

grammar.name: 宾语从句转述
grammar.note: reminds me that... 是宾语从句,传达老师的提醒;复杂结构与简单句形成对比。

options.text: The teacher reminds him to use more complex structures.
options.feedback: 老师提醒他复杂句式更能打动考官。

options.text: Simple sentences always impress the examiners most.
options.feedback: 老师的观点正相反:复杂结构才令人印象深刻。

options.text: The student never listens to his teacher's advice.
options.feedback: 学生只是陈述现状,并未说不听劝告。

rounds.speaker: 写作老师
rounds.line: This paragraph lacks a topic sentence, which means the main point is not clear to the reader.
rounds.lineCn: 这一段缺少主题句,这意味着读者看不清段落要点。

grammar.name: 非限制性定语从句指代整句
grammar.note: which means... 中 which 指代前面整个事实(缺少主题句),写作批改常用句式。

options.text: The paragraph is unclear because it lacks a topic sentence.
options.feedback: 缺少主题句导致要点不清晰。

options.text: The paragraph is perfect and needs no changes.
options.feedback: 老师明确指出了段落的问题。

options.text: The reader always understands the point immediately.
options.feedback: 原文说要点不清晰,读者难以把握。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: I will memorize several advanced sentence patterns and adapt them to different essay topics.
rounds.lineCn: 我会记住几个高级句型,并把它们套用到不同的作文题目上。

grammar.name: 句型迁移运用
grammar.note: memorize... and adapt them 是并列谓语;them 指代句型,体现句型举一反三的用法。

options.text: He will memorize patterns and apply them to various topics.
options.feedback: 记住句型并灵活迁移到不同题目。

options.text: He will use one fixed pattern for every essay topic.
options.feedback: 他要做的是灵活适配,而非一套句型走天下。

options.text: He will stop learning new sentence patterns.
options.feedback: 他恰恰要继续积累句型。
